decisions.reason: Route A needs one interpretable candidate identity per treatment; a heterogeneous top-k>1 bundle would make attribution of any effect ambiguous.

Family-match diagnostics did not decisively favor any of lexical/BGE-small/BGE-M3 (all ~19-21% top-1, ~42-44% top-3), so the choice is not diagnostic-driven. BGE-M3 is preferred because ESC-Eval's primary RQ1 transfer set spans non-ESConv sources (ExTES/MHP/Psych/EPITOME), favoring semantic over lexical matching, and it unifies the retrieval stack with RQ2's typed-memory BGE-M3 usage.

decisions.reason: guidance-only collapsed to 8 distinct rendered strings (not really a 12k-card resource); guidance+exemplar retained per-card identity but carried source-specific person/kinship/number content (5963/605/594 cards respectively per prior audit). Using the same frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct tokenizer for both sides, atomic-move rendered cards are ~87.2% shorter than guidance+exemplar (16 vs 125 median tokens) and pass a fail-closed leak scan on action_description, while remaining card-specific (not collapsed to a handful of templates). This single-dialogue smoke is engineering evidence that the compiler pipeline works end-to-end; it is not yet evidence of cross-dialogue quality stability -- see rs_diverse_compiler_qa_pending below.

listen-only/no-advice/no-probing boundaries activate extremely rarely under either horizon definition (1/11883 vs 9/11883 states); the simpler, more defensible current-run-only definition is adopted since the choice has negligible practical impact.
